thread:
maria-g: heads up — we've started seeing intermittent gRPC bidi streams stall when proxied through the edge in eu-west1. ~1-2% of streaming connections pause mid-session for 20–90s then reset. Impacting realtime sessions (voice transcribe).

chris-k: thanks, any pattern on client IPs / upstream nodes? or only heavy sessions?

maria-g: looks fairly distributed, correlates with bursts of short-lived upstream connections from the ML pool. spikes in ephemeral port usage around same time.

adah: can you paste a tcpdump / log of a stalled connection? especially any TLS FIN/RST or HTTP/2 WINDOW_UPDATE spam.

maria-g: pasted a short capture below (masked IPs). shows client -> edge(nginx-envoy) -> backend. stall starts after a long series of small DATA frames, then no DATA for ~45s, then reset.

```
14:02:11.123 IP client -> edge: TLS Application Data
14:02:11.124 IP edge -> backend: TLS Application Data
14:02:11.200 IP client -> edge: TLS Application Data
...
14:02:12.800 IP edge -> backend: WINDOW_UPDATE stream 0 + conn-level
14:02:12.801 IP backend -> edge: DATA (small chunk)
14:02:12.802 IP edge -> client: DATA (small chunk)
14:02:12.803 --- then silence ---
14:02:58.900 IP edge -> client: RST
```

chris-k: hmm. edge sending WINDOW_UPDATE then we stop seeing upstream DATA — could be proxy buffer/backpressure or conntrack hitting ephemeral port reuse and reassigning sockets to new flows. Are we hitting NAT port exhaustion on the NAT gateways?

infra-bot: nat-gateway-eu-west1: conntrack-sockets=48672/65535, tcp_fin_wait=312, ephemeral-ports-in-use=48200

maria-g: infra-bot shows conntrack nearing high-water in that window. We also had a deployment that increased worker restart churn earlier this morning.

kevin-s: another angle: some older edge proxy versions had a bug where HTTP/2 flow-control stalls if downstream responses are delivered in tiny fragments and the proxy's write buffer gets a soft-limit — it stops polling for upstream because of backpressure accounting mismatch. We had a fix in 1.18.4 that avoided marking streams stalled incorrectly. Which proxy version are we on?

maria-g: running envoy 1.18.2 in the edge pool.

adah: that tracks. two-pronged: 1) short-term mitigation: increase keepalive/idle timeouts and bump conntrack table size on NATs; also increase proxy upstream buffer limits and reduce max concurrent streams per connection to lower multiplexing pressure. 2) long-term: roll edge to 1.18.6+ which includes the h2 write buffer/backpressure fix and better socket drain semantics.

chris-k: suggested commands: on NATs bump conntrack: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072` and tune `nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established` down a bit. For envoy, try `--overload-manager` thresholds and `http2.max_concurrent_streams` to 100 per worker as a test.

maria-g: going to run a canary: increase conntrack to 130k in eu-west, set envoy max_concurrent_streams -> 80 in canary pool, and enable debug logs for h2 flow control. will report back in 20m.

ops-oncall: also drop a temporary rate-limiter on new upstream connects from the ml pool to smooth port churn (throttle restarts) — avoid spikes.

20m later — maria-g: canary looks promising. stalled rate down from ~1.6% -> 0.15% on the canary subset. conntrack headroom increased, and envoy canary didn't hit the write-buffer threshold.

kevin-s: good. next steps: schedule a staged edge roll to 1.18.6 with the backpressure fix, permanent conntrack increases in eu-west, and add an alert for ephemeral-port-usage > 75% with 5m window + runbook linking to this thread.

chris-k: I'll open a rollout PR and coordinate with SRE for the NAT sysctl change (needs infra-change approval).

maria-g: thanks all — tagging @prod-alerts to keep eyes on related SLOs. leaving debug h2 logs on for another hour, will collect and attach full traces if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: filed INC-4472 to track rollout and infra change.

infra-bot: task created: INC-4472 assigned to chris-k

maria-g: attaching here the small debug trace (uploaded to internal storage) — link: https://redwood.internal/trace/1998765432-debug

adah: saving notes into knowledge base: "edge h2 small-chunk backpressure + conntrack exhaustion -> intermittent stream stalls" with steps to reproduce and mitigations.

maria-g: closing loop — will follow-up after rollouts.
